name: Kokorone=Pendulum!
original_name: ココロネ=ペンデュラム！
source:
Around 30 years ago, superpowers known as ‘magia’ started appearing in Japan. Soujirou recently gained the ability to read other people’s minds. Normally these powers would awaken in people over the course of a few days, but for him, it took a full two years. Furthermore, he isn’t able to control his ability well and it gives him headaches from time to time. With the intention of getting rid of it, he decided to enroll in Shizuka-no-Umi Academy in Saema, a leading academic research city where magia users (saucers) gathered.

However, he was caught up in an incident on his first day and saw a fellow magia saucer for the first time. The girl Sumika used her power which can heal even the most serious illnesses, and he was so captivated by her that he wished to become just like her. Thus, he started to learn how to properly use his magia with fellow students Chihaya, Leeruu, Tsumuri and his younger sister Nazuna, the most powerful magia saucer in the school.

[Slightly edited from [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2019/07/05/july-2019-eroge-releases/]Hau~Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
大约30年前，被称为“magia”的超能力开始在日本出现。总次郎最近获得了读懂别人心思的能力。正常情况下，这些力量在人身上觉醒几天之内就能觉醒，但对他来说，却足足花了两年的时间。而且，他对自己的能力控制不好，时不时的就让他头疼。为了摆脱这种束缚，他决定入读位于魔法使用者（碟子）聚集的领先学术研究城市佐马的静香海学园。

然而，他第一天就遭遇了意外，第一次见到了魔法碟同伴。女孩纯香使用她的力量治愈最严重的疾病，他被她迷住了，他希望成为像她一样的人。于是，他开始和同学千早、乐流、津布里以及学园里最强的魔法碟妹妹荠一起学习如何正确使用魔法。

[稍微编辑自 [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2019/07/05/july-2019-eroge-releases/]Hau~Omochikaeri！[/url]]
